description: Qualité de l'eau potable des 12 derniers mois is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministère des Solidarités et de la Santé. Analyses des prélèvements d'eau potable sur les réseaux de distribution de l’eau potable, ou sur les installations directement en amont. Un réseau peut alimenter plusieurs communes: chaque prélèvement a été dupliqué pour toutes les communes du réseau. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are eau potable, qualité, robinet. The portal shows 329,446 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-08-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
